structured.feedback: Structurally sound and within length, but it breaks the explicit style rules: passive constructions ("Launched by...", "Formulated for...", "is typically enough") violate the active-voice requirement, and repeated words ("clean" x2, "routine" x2, "everyday" x2, "fresh" x2) make the copy repetitive and generic. The features-vs-benefits distinction is also only loosely drawn.
